rules.quote: Representation: Fixed length of six digits
rules.statement: Sequence Number has six ASCII digits.
rules.condition: A transaction carries Element 86; this representation does not prove sequence allocation or uniqueness.

rules.quote: Sequence Number must persist in all the subsequent transactions that are associated with the initial authorization request.
rules.statement: Associated follow-up retains the original authorization sequence.
rules.condition: An independently eligible follow-up is associated with an initial authorization; original sequence is supplied.

rules.quote: Representation: Fixed length of three bytes, right-aligned and padded with zeroes
rules.statement: EMV Card Sequence Number occupies three ASCII bytes.
rules.condition: Applicable ICC transaction containing Element 188; this is width only, not tag agreement or cryptographic validity.

rules.quote: The device performs expiration date validation in a credit card transaction.
rules.statement: Credit processing performs expiration validation.
rules.condition: Electronic credit processing under section 10.1; excludes debit and separately governed product profiles.

rules.quote: For all other card types, the default track should be Track 2.
rules.statement: Non-Amex credit defaults to Track 2.
rules.condition: Section 10.1 electronic credit magnetic-stripe initial transaction; device supports readable Track 2; not EMV or a follow-up.

rules.quote: If the device cannot read Track 2, then the device should send unaltered Track 1 on the initial transaction, before attempting manual entry.
rules.statement: Unreadable Track 2 falls back to unaltered Track 1 before manual entry.
rules.condition: Initial non-Amex electronic credit magnetic-stripe transaction; Track 2 unreadable, Track 1 readable.

rules.quote: Track 1 data is mandatory for all (both MSR and MSD) Amex AFD transactions
rules.statement: Amex MSR/MSD AFD carries Track 1.
rules.condition: Amex AFD using MSR or MSD; not a universal entry-mode requirement.

rules.quote: Track 1 data must be present inside the Encryption Block with Encryption Target as Track 1.
rules.statement: Encrypted Amex AFD selects Track 1 as encryption target.
rules.condition: Amex AFD contains encrypted data in the TransArmor Encryption Block; Track 1 content separately checked.

rules.quote: The amount in a Reversal (Void) request must be the amount approved in the original transaction response when a transaction has been partially approved.
rules.statement: Partial-approval credit reversal uses the approved amount.
rules.condition: Network supports partial approval; original partially approved response and eligible reversal are supplied. Not TOR.

rules.quote: must be present and identical in the Authorization Only Reversal transaction.
rules.statement: Credit authorization reversal preserves the approval number.
rules.condition: Eligible section 10.1.2.2 POS/CAT Authorization Only Reversal; original approval number present; field identity as named in this clause requires review against element catalog.

rules.quote: Manual entry is not allowed on a debit card transaction.
rules.statement: Standard Interlink PIN-debit does not allow manual entry.
rules.condition: Transaction is independently classified under section 10.2 PIN-debit processing; do not apply to Signature Debit or PINless profiles.

rules.quote: it must be encrypted using the DUKPT PIN encryption method.
rules.statement: Applicable PIN-debit encrypts the PIN using DUKPT.
rules.condition: Section 10.2 PIN entry is required; excludes Purchase Reversal PIN exception; method label is not cryptographic proof.

rules.quote: Any response from BUYPASS to a Debit Card Completion transaction should end attempts to retry a Debit Card Completion
rules.statement: A received debit completion response stops retries.
rules.condition: BUYPASS response received for a Debit Card Completion, whether approved or declined.

rules.quote: Interlink requires that merchants supporting cashback must also support Partial Approval transactions.
rules.statement: Interlink cashback merchants support Partial Approval.
rules.condition: Merchant supports Interlink cashback; not proof every card or transaction permits cashback.

rules.quote: The amount in a TOR request must be the amount approved in the original transaction response when a transaction has been partially approved.
rules.statement: Partially approved PIN-debit TOR uses approved amount.
rules.condition: Eligible section 10.2 partially approved debit transaction; not a debit Completion TOR.

rules.quote: The transaction must be settled only in US Dollar (840)
rules.statement: STAR Signature Debit settlement currency is USD 840.
rules.condition: Confirmed STAR Signature Debit single- or dual-message processing; routing and US/territory requirements separately reviewed.

rules.quote: Cash back is not supported
rules.statement: STAR Signature Debit excludes cashback.
rules.condition: Confirmed STAR Signature Debit single- or dual-message profile.

rules.quote: eCommerce transactions, including those using 3-D Secure Protocol, such as Verified by Visa, MC Secure code transactions, Amex SafeKey and Discover ProtectBuy are not supported
rules.statement: STAR Signature Debit excludes eCommerce.
rules.condition: Confirmed STAR Signature Debit single- or dual-message profile; source states eCommerce is not supported.

rules.quote: The transactions cannot be keyed
rules.statement: STAR single-message transactions cannot be keyed.
rules.condition: Confirmed STAR Signature Debit single-message processing; do not extend to generic Signature Debit.

rules.quote: Transactions must have the final amount same as the original authorization amount
rules.statement: STAR single-message final amount matches authorization.
rules.condition: Confirmed STAR Signature Debit single-message authorization and associated final transaction.

rules.quote: Contains the same Sequence Number as the estimated or initial transaction request.
rules.statement: Visa incremental authorization retains initial sequence.
rules.condition: Permitted merchant and eligible Visa Appendix AE incremental transaction; initial authorization supplied.

rules.quote: Contains the same Transaction Identifier in Segment as the estimated or initial transaction request.
rules.statement: Visa incremental authorization retains initial transaction identifier.
rules.condition: Eligible Appendix AE incremental; logical identifier supplied; source omits segment number so wire placement remains unresolved.

rules.quote: Contains the same Terminal transaction number (Table ID 63 in Segment 111) as the estimated or initial transaction request.
rules.statement: Visa incremental retains initial terminal transaction number.
rules.condition: Eligible Appendix AE incremental authorization with supplied original Table 63 terminal transaction number.

rules.quote: Only follows an estimated / initial authorization.
rules.statement: Visa incremental follows an initial authorization.
rules.condition: Eligible Appendix AE incremental lifecycle; ordered logical transaction roles, not wire messages.

rules.quote: will expire 14 days after the initial estimated authorization.
rules.statement: Visa lodging, cruise and car-rental window remains anchored to initial authorization.
rules.condition: Permitted cruise, lodging or car/vehicle rental merchant; elapsed calendar days from initial, not latest incremental; timestamp/timezone cutoff unresolved.

rules.quote: will expire seven days after the initial estimated authorization.
rules.statement: Visa other-rental window is seven days from initial authorization.
rules.condition: Permitted other-rental merchant, such as trailer park or campground; elapsed calendar days; not an exhaustive MCC mapping or timestamp cutoff.

rules.quote: All IA transaction types should contain Incremental Auth Data (Variable Information segment 111 Table 82). This is mandatory for Discover.
rules.statement: Discover IA transactions carry Segment 111 Table 82.
rules.condition: Discover Appendix AF Original Auth, Incremental Auth, IA Reversal or IA Completion; not all ordinary Discover transactions.

rules.quote: Incremental Auths, IA Reversals, and IA Completions are all subsequent transactions, and must be preceded by an Original Auth.
rules.statement: Discover subsequent IA transactions follow Original Auth.
rules.condition: Eligible Appendix AF logical lifecycle; no host approval or merchant permission inferred.

rules.quote: Subsequent IA transactions must contain the Approval Code (DE 39) that was received on the approved Original Auth.
rules.statement: Discover subsequent IA preserves approved Original Auth approval code.
rules.condition: Original Auth approved; subsequent IA transaction independently eligible; response-derived approval supplied.

rules.quote: Once an IA Completion is received, the IA is closed, and no more subsequent transactions will be approved for that Terminal Transaction ID.
rules.statement: Discover IA completion closes subsequent activity for that terminal transaction ID.
rules.condition: Ordered roles for one supplied Terminal Transaction ID; completion received; cross-ID allocation and host responses not simulated.

decisions.question: Approve complete release-qualified denominator, atomicity, legacy scope and overlaps for each network.
Confirm Interlink PIN/PINless and savings/ACH eligibility, entry modes and routing independently; no Maestro inheritance.
Resolve Amex general track wording precedence, credit TOR amount wording and approval-field naming discrepancy.
Confirm Visa Appendix AE versus AF eligibility, field placement, expiry timestamp and rollover; do not apply Visa windows to Discover.
Supply remaining network deliveries, fleet/program-specific authority and actual subtype/routing evidence.
Supply full-message wire, device, crypto, original-response and host evidence; synthetic observations cannot certify execution.
